title: REPLCONF ACK 心跳上报 offset 与 lag 计算
expected_output:
=== REPLCONF ACK 心跳与 lag 模拟 ===
t=0 主从一致 master_offset=slave_offset=100
t=1 主节点写入5条命令, master_offset = 105
t=1 从节点 REPLCONF ACK 上报 slave_offset = 103
主节点计算复制滞后 lag = master_offset - slave_offset = 2
判定: lag=2 (落后, 摘出读池)
t=2 从节点 REPLCONF ACK 上报 slave_offset = 105
lag = 0 -> 追平
code:
print("=== REPLCONF ACK 心跳与 lag 模拟 ===")
master_offset = 100
slave_offset = 100
print("t=0 主从一致 master_offset=slave_offset=100")
for i in range(5):
    master_offset += 1
print("t=1 主节点写入5条命令, master_offset =", master_offset)
slave_offset += 3
print("t=1 从节点 REPLCONF ACK 上报 slave_offset =", slave_offset)
lag = master_offset - slave_offset
print("主节点计算复制滞后 lag = master_offset - slave_offset =", lag)
print("判定: lag=%d (%s)" % (lag, "正常" if lag <= 1 else "落后, 摘出读池"))
slave_offset = master_offset
print("t=2 从节点 REPLCONF ACK 上报 slave_offset =", slave_offset)
print("lag =", master_offset - slave_offset, "-> 追平")
